budget: Editable hypothetical planning inputs, not live hotel rates, fare quotes or price averages. Flights, insurance, shopping and any omitted costs must be added by the traveler.
passes: Compare only eligible charged journeys after transfers. Exclude airport boarding at Incheon, uncovered stations/operators, airport/express buses, GTX and Sinbundang. A short pass runs by service days rather than rolling 24-hour periods. Check the official coverage before purchase.
airport: A planning comparison, not a live route engine. No fare, timetable, booking or step-free availability is guaranteed.
map: Overview markers are not verified entrances or live routes. Use current official/local navigation for exact access.
